items.date_raw: September 2024 (reported September 27, 2024; described as having been in the role for approximately one week on October 9, 2024)
items.citation_text: Ontario appointment reported by South Simcoe Today; corroborating sector coverage
items.verbatim_snippet: Eric Hanna was appointed by Ontario as hospital supervisor after investigator Janice Skot’s final report identified concerns involving the hospital’s governance, leadership, quality of care, operations and financial performance.

items.date_raw: June 2025 (reported June 8, 2025; still identified as supervisor on January 30 and March 9, 2026)

items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo was appointed as Hanna’s successor in 2025.
